timed_text.text: Day 28, who are you when it gets hard?
Who are you behind, two mistakes back to back, with everything on the line?
Think back to where you were when this journey started.
There was probably a version of you with no answer for that question.
That got swallowed by the moment.
You've been building the answer for 28 days.
The mental training doesn't change you in the comfortable moments.
It reveals you in the difficult ones.
Every rep preparing you for that moment — the one that used to break you.
Today I want you to write your competition identity.
The version of you when everything is on the line and against you.
On your screen we're going to take a breath and then we write.

cards.prompt: Write your competition identity statement — specifically for your hardest moment. Who are you when the game is on the line, you're behind, and everything hurts? Present tense. 'I am an athlete who...'

timed_text.text: Read that before every competition from here forward.
Not as a wish as a reminder of a decision you've already made.
You have a journal prompt and after you finish, day 28 is complete.

blocks.prompt: When was the last time you actually lived out that identity in competition? What made it possible?
